name: Standings Differential Single
description: Back the shrunken net-points favorite each week
selection_rule: Take model favorite to cover own model spread — graded against own line first (market grading pending)

name: Deficiency Fade
description: Fade teams whose official starter-deficiency load exceeds opponent by >=2.0 points weight
selection_rule: Side against the more-injured team when SG03 gap >=2.0 and both teams' charts verified

name: QB-Change Total
description: Play the under when a team starts a QB other than its Week-1 official starter
selection_rule: Official inactives show chart QB1 inactive -> under on that game's total

name: Chain-Degradation Parlay
description: Two-leg parlay on teams whose effective replacement is 3rd string or deeper
selection_rule: Both legs: starter Out and effective replacement at 3rd/4th string or no listed backup; legs from different games only
gate_status: pending — G4 correlation value not yet computable

name: Player-Prop Combo
description: Correlated player-prop combos (e.g. QB pass yards + WR receptions)
selection_rule: Combo both legs from same official game-log production baselines
inputs: No official prop source exists in any NFL-published feed
blocked_by: Q13 (no official prop source; policy decision required)

name: Luck-Fade Single
description: Fade teams whose actual wins exceed Pythagorean expectation by >=1.5
selection_rule: Bet against team with luck_index >= +1.5 until regression; symmetrically back luck_index <= -1.5

name: Model-vs-Market QA
description: Not a staking strategy: compares own lines to captured market lines
selection_rule: Requires captured market spreads with timestamp and operator
